title: Faith-based homelessness recommendations and strategic plan
summary: A homelessness commission working group recommended ways to involve faith-based groups, fund district data on unsheltered people and have county departments include the commission, with votes planned at a later meeting. A final draft homeless strategic plan was due December 20 and was to go on the January agenda.

timeline.text: A testifier doing outreach reported a large increase in unhoused people using their services.
The director asked the chair to put the homeless strategic plan on the January agenda.
The commission will decide whether to approve each recommendation at its next meeting.
The working group met with about 18 churches at three locations.
The commission plans to vote on each recommendation at a later meeting.
Another asks the mayor to direct all County departments to include the commission in homelessness programs and policies.
Another asks for grant funding to collect district-by-district data on unsheltered people.
A working group presented recommendations on involving faith-based groups in fighting homelessness.
